impact: Two project documents disagree, so this needs a decision rather than a fix. cloudbuild.yaml sets CORS_ORIGINS=* and index.ts reflects whatever Origin the request carries; CLAUDE.md records this as deliberate, because the real serving URL is a bare Cloud Run hostname and an earlier attempt at an exact origin broke login with Better Auth's "Invalid origin" error. PROJECT_RECOMMENDATIONS treats it as a scheduled fix. Whichever wins, one of the two documents should stop saying the other thing. Note the constraint before deciding: any tightening has to survive the fact that no custom domain is mapped.
title: CORS_ORIGINS is wide open: the audit says tighten it, CLAUDE.md says it is intentional
